release_scope: Planning/control-plane milestone: deterministic source acquisition control surface after locked v1.4.0-alpha.6 — Provider Execution Harness Mock-to-Live Equivalence, locked v1.4.0-alpha.5 — Dry-Run Replay Pack + Operator Approval Simulation, locked v1.4.0-alpha.4 — Dry-Run Trace Inspector + Execution Readiness Report, and locked v1.3.0 — Stable Manual Workflow Release. Adds source acquisition mode selector semantics for manual_source, imported_evidence, fixture_source, provider_proposed_source, blocked_source, and future_controlled_fetch; permission/provenance/risk labels; review queue compatibility; source-to-claim linkage preservation; and source gap warnings. It does not enable live scraping, live source fetching, hidden background fetching, production OAuth, backend behavior, storage expansion, provider-suggested source bypass, automatic source verification, automatic signoff, automatic export lock, cryptographic signing, or publication permission claims.
